Post 1

ASX barely moved — 8,783.90, up just 0.70 points — but underneath, tech cratered 4.37% while banks and utilities surged. Flat index, violent rotation. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

📉 Info Tech -4.37%, Materials -2.03% dragged hard. 🔺 Utilities +1.80%, Financials +1.39%, Consumer Staples +1.31% picked up the slack. Classic defensives-in, growth-out rotation. #ASX #banking #energy

Post 3

📉 Megaport dropped 9.91% to AUD 17.73 — the sharpest large-cap tech fall of the session. With the sector down 4.37%, this wasn't stock-specific pain; the whole growth trade got repriced today. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,040.15/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6966. A softer Aussie dollar is quietly amplifying local gold returns — worth watching if the currency slips further. #gold #ASX #ausbiz

Post 5

Tech's 4.37% single-session drop is the number to watch. Does the sector stabilise or does rotation into defensives deepen? What's your read — dead-cat bounce in tech tomorrow or more selling? #ASX #ausbiz
